meta.name: Worst Ex Ever
meta.description:
From chilling betrayals to murder plots, this true-crime docuseries dissects the dark side of love through eyewitness testimonies.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 28 Aug 2024 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Blumhouse Television, ITV America · Network: Netflix

videos.title: Dating the Devil
videos.overview: Justine's alarming call to a friend leads to a shocking discovery and a statewide police hunt for Ben, a recent partner with a monstrous dating history.

videos.title: Betrayed by the Badge
videos.overview: After Seemona learns her boyfriend, Jerry, lied about his identity, she breaks things off — only for him to launch a campaign of torment against her.

videos.title: Killing for Custody
videos.overview: A long custody battle turns Eric into the target of a malicious scheme by his ex-wife, Rosa, and her mother. Caught in the crossfire: Eric's grandmother.

videos.title: Married to a Monster
videos.overview: Amanda and Kevin's seemingly perfect romance crumbles when marriage exposes his controlling nature. After their divorce, a chilling murder plot unfolds.
